priority.description: This feature is not supported for MlJobOptions

disabled.description: This feature is not supported for MlJobOptions

maxConcurrency.description: Upper bound on total number {@link MlWorkflowCoordinatableResult}s to execute in parallel.

maxConcurrencyPerNode.description: This feature is not supported for MlJobOptions

runAsUser.description: This feature is not supported for MlJobOptions

skipIfRunning.description: This feature is not supported for MlJobOptions

numAutoRecoveryAttempts.description: Set to between 1 and 5 to enable auto recovery. See {@link invalidation-queues.c3doc Invalidation Queues} for detailed documentation.

jobTimeoutMinutes.description: Maximum time allocated for execution of a {@link MlSubject.OperationJob}.

doNotRecoverCanceled.description: Flag to indicate if {@link MlWorkflowCoordinatable#recover} should recover canceled results along with errored results.

start.description:
Start datetime of the time range. The start date is inclusive of the date mentioned.
E.g. '2010-01-01T00:00:00' (everything starting from '2011-01-01T00:00:00' will be included)

end.description:
End datetime of the time range. The end date is exclusive of the date mentioned.
E.g. '2011-01-01T00:00:00' (everything before '2011-01-01T00:00:00' will be included)

statusFilter.description:
Filter to get a subset of the models; the filter is applied on the {@link MlModel.Route.Status}
of the {@link MlModel.Route routes} applicable to the subject.

project.description: The project from which the models are retrieved.

doNotHandleOutputs.description:
If `true`, {@link MlModel.OutputHandler output handlers} specified on {@link MlModel.Route relevant routes}
won't be processed.

xSnapshotIds.description:
Map of {@link MlModel} `x` inputs names to corresponding snapshot ids for feature sets.
The {@link Feature.Set.Snapshot}s for snapshot ids is expected to be created by users prior to supplying snapshot ids
for executing a {@link MlSubject.OperationJob}.
The keys of this map must be same or subset of keys of {@link MlModel#xFeatures}.

ySnapshotIds.description:
Map of {@link MlModel} `y` inputs names to corresponding snapshot ids for feature sets.
The {@link Feature.Set.Snapshot}s for snapshot ids is expected to be created by users prior to supplying snapshot ids
for executing a {@link MlSubject.OperationJob}.
The keys of this map must be same or subset of keys of {@link MlModel#yFeatures}.

xProjections.description:
Map of {@link EvalFeatureSpec#projection} for {@link #xFeatures}.
The keys of this map must be same or subset of keys of {@link MlModel#xFeatures}.
The values of this map are comma-separated feature names to evaluate.
For example, for a feature set named 'metricFs' with features 'f1', 'f2', 'f3',
if we want to evaluate only the feature 'f1' and 'f2', we can use either "f1, f2" or "metricFs.f1, metricFs.f2".
If the {@link MlModel model} is trained or already has {@link MlModel#xProjections projections} set,
providing this value would raise an error.

yProjections.description:
Map of {@link EvalFeatureSpec#projection} for {@link #yFeatures}.
The keys of this map must be same or subset of keys of {@link MlModel#yFeatures}.
The values of this map are comma-separated feature names to evaluate.
For example, for a feature set named 'metricFs' with features 'f1', 'f2', 'f3',
if we want to evaluate only the feature 'f1' and 'f2', we can use either "f1, f2" or "metricFs.f1, metricFs.f2".
If the {@link MlModel model} is trained or already has {@link MlModel#yProjections projections} set,
providing this value would raise an error.

snapshotId.description:
Optional globally unique ID of a "snapshot" of a Feature

If no snapshot exists then will evaluate with current state of Feature and will persist it a snapshot with provided
id

operationTimeoutMinutes.description: Maximum time to wait for a single {@link MlModel} operation to complete.

subjectFilter.description: Filter applied on the project to get the {@link MlSubject}s to process on.

batchSize.description: The size of each batch (number of {@link MlSubject}s).

batchInterval.description:
If provided, the job will not only distribute across {@link MlSubject}s but also over time by slicing the
time range defined by {@link start} and {@link end} into slices of the given interval.
This is useful if you process for a large period and you want to split up the work in even more
{@link MlSubject.Batch}es.

Note that if either {@link start} or {@link end} is `null`, this field is ignored and no slicing is performed.

Example: if there is exactly one week between {@link start} and {@link end}, and if `interval` is
{@link Interval#DAY DAY}, then 7 batches will be created for the each batch of subjects.

title: Spec for running ML operations on MlSubject at a large scale. Ex: {@link MlSubject.ProcessJob}, {@link MlSubject.InterpretJob}.
